Rae (CSM): Heads-up — AeroData traffic dropped dramatically after PoC wrap. Dashboard shows ~92% decline since the demo. Anyone watching?
Ethan (AE): Yep. Procurement introduced a new ML lead, Milo, last week. They're running an OrionML side-by-side and asked for an end-to-end throughput benchmark.
Pri (Solutions Eng): Any config changes on our side around the drop window? model swap or quantize rollout?
Rae (CSM): quick query I ran: ```SELECT day, sum(requests) FROM api_calls WHERE account='aerodata' AND day>='2025-12-01' GROUP BY day;``` cliff on 2025-12-08.
fin-bot: invoice AD-2025-12 created 2025-12-09 — status: unpaid.
Milo (AeroData): Hi team — we paused live traffic while we validate cost and throughput. OrionML demoed an aggressive prefetch + batch-scheduler that cut token counts in their tests. Also our security team wants a VPC diagram and KMS key policy.
Jade (AeroData): procurement also asked for a 2-hour stress run showing p95 latency at 50rps sustained.
Pri (Solutions Eng): mitigation plan: enable prefix KV caching for top templates, enable prefetch and adaptive batching, and run a 2-hour E2E stress test on a dedicated pool. We'll produce a token-cost sim and p95 numbers.
Ethan (AE): I'll prepare a short competitive slide comparing per-request cost and commit options. Rae — can you send VPC/KMS + SOC2 checklist?
Rae (CSM): on it. Draft outreach: "Milo/Jade — we can fast-track the security pack and run a 5-day no-charge dedicated trial including a 2-hour sustained throughput test and token-cost side-by-side with OrionML. Can we schedule a call to align?"
Milo (AeroData): That works. Security would like the VPC/KMS docs before the test. Thu 4pm our time works for a call.
Pri (Solutions Eng): action items: Pri -> perf test plan + KV config; Ethan -> competitive slide + trial terms; Rae -> send security pack + schedule. fin-bot: payment reminder sent to customer billing contact.
Rae (CSM): marking as high priority. Will update thread after Thu call. :eyes:
